acceptanceCriteria: corvint frontier over a default cem/1.0 change map produces the frontier view through a stable ACCEPT, with refusal controls for a tampered map and a wrong base.
conformance/host-lifecycle-v1's frontier case prepares the default cem/1.0 map.
body: Source: V1-1276 builder report and docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1276-dogfood-producer-cem-1-0.md 'Limits and NOT_RUN' (PR beamfall/corvint#837, merge 9deae4838). Decision 0525: RC3 ships cem/1.0 only; V1-1278 removes the 0.x readers, so each surface below must read cem/1.0 before or with that removal. With the V1-1276 binary, frontier admits only cem/0.2 and refuses a cem/1.0 map with unsupported-frontier-context, so the reviewer's frontier view is NOT_PRODUCED for every new dogfood map; conformance/host-lifecycle-v1 pins its frontier case's prepare to --spec cem/0.2. Related: V1-0632 rows C06/C08 (frontierrepo.RecomputeStable keeps frontier NOT_PRODUCED).
title: Frontier: admit a verified cem/1.0 change map instead of refusing unsupported-frontier-context
